quotes.text: setCalendarEventRoute does not wait or queue a later switch. It skips the superclass call during pending edit Save. The route can identify another event or occurrence, so switching the calendar alone is too narrow.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For D332899 at revision 3e22f6ce2506a323aecd485c174f9dab1c3a0298, the AI assessment reports that setCalendarEventRoute immediately skips the superclass call while edit Save is pending; it does not wait or queue a switch. Documentation should describe ignored route changes, which can target another event or occurrence, rather than only a calendar switch. Create-session replacement has a separate contract. Focused browser tests reportedly passed, but the proposed documentation change was not accepted.
title: Pending edit Save ignores route changes
